post.description: Returns a bounded set of virtual object identities discovered from state and pending work. Pending work includes unfinished exclusive and shared invocations, plus state-mutation entries when virtual queues are available. An inactive instance without state cannot be enumerated. scope.description: Part of the virtual object identity. Omitted for an unscoped object.

duration.description: Elapsed time from the run's first start until completion, or until now while it is still running.

waitingToStartDuration.description: Live time spent runnable but not yet started. Present only before the first start.

pendingPromiseCount.description: Number of unresolved durable promises belonging to this Workflow run.

lastInteractionAt.description: Creation time of the most recent invocation of a non-run Workflow handler.

inboxCount.description: Exact number of entries currently in the inbox for this Virtual Object instance.

rows.description: Invocations, plus VQueue entries that are not invocations (e.g. state mutations) without invocation details.

min.description: Minimum per-VQueue exponential moving average as an ISO 8601 duration.

max.description: Maximum per-VQueue exponential moving average as an ISO 8601 duration.

vqueueCount.description: Number of VQueues with a recorded sample contributing to the range.

numKeys.description: Number of state keys stored by this keyed service instance.

totalSize.description: Total state value size in bytes. State-key bytes and storage overhead are excluded.

numInbox.description: Number of entries currently inboxed across this Virtual Object instance's Virtual Queues.

flowControl.description: Present only when includeFlowControl was requested and queue metadata was available.

rows.description: Invocations, plus VQueue entries that are not invocations (e.g. state mutations) without invocation details.

view.description: Selects the response sections. Stages returns every coarse stage and service total; live-stages returns only non-completed stage and service totals; breakdowns returns inner status distributions; count applies every filter and returns only the total; all returns both complete stages and breakdowns; deployments returns per-deployment status totals in deploymentBuckets and is only served from deployment stats.

highlightFields.description: For bucket views, filters on these fields do not restrict the aggregate population and matching buckets are marked with isIncluded instead. The count view always applies every filter.

key.description: Stable key for this response-defined bucket. It may represent several invocation statuses.

statuses.description: Invocation status filter values represented by this bucket.

isIncluded.description: Whether this bucket matches the removed status highlight filters.

statusBreakdown.description: Exact per-status counts for this service, using the same buckets as the top-level statusBuckets. Present only when the summary is served from stats.

handlerBuckets.description: Per-handler stage totals for this service. Present only when the summary is served from stats; entries without a handler (state mutations) are not included.

isIncluded.description: Whether this bucket matches the removed target_service_name highlight filters.

statuses.description: Invocation status filter values represented by this stage.

breakdownIsPartial.description: Whether this stage's inner status distribution came from a bounded population.

breakdownCoverage.description: The status granularity currently available inside this stage.

breakdownCanRefine.description: Whether another breakdown view of this endpoint can safely provide more granular status buckets.

isIncluded.description: Whether this stage contains a status matched by the removed status highlight filters.

queryDurationMs.description: Time spent executing and assembling this summary response in the query handler, in milliseconds.

stageCountsArePartial.description: Whether the coarse stage totals are derived from a bounded population rather than exact metadata counters.

deploymentBuckets.description: Per-deployment totals for the deployments view, read from deployment stats; only entries already assigned to a deployment are counted.

groupBy.description: Selects one physical aggregation. Due does not group by status; status does not calculate first-runnable due state.

mode.description: Bounds the global VQueue status breakdown. Due breakdowns and service-filtered requests remain exact within their selected population.

serviceNames.description: Filter by service. VQueue mode bounds the metadata population to one million queues and conservatively reports the result as partial without a separate population-count query.

FinishedInvocationsBreakdownV2RequestBod.description: Defaults to a bounded sampled breakdown; request exact mode explicitly when a full retained-finished scan is acceptable.

startTime.description: Inclusive completion-time lower bound on transitioned_at.

endTime.description: Exclusive completion-time upper bound on transitioned_at.

rulePattern.description: Return only the rule with this exact pattern.

includeUnlimited.description: Include runtime counters without a matching rule. Defaults to false.

rulePattern.description: Return only counters governed by this exact rule pattern.

filters.description: Structured limit-counter filters combined with AND. Scope and whole limit key support case-insensitive exact equality and literal substring matching. L1 and L2 support case-insensitive exact equality.

Structured VQueue filters combined with AND. Supported fields are id, service, serviceKey, scope, limitKey, l1, l2, and lockName. String comparisons are case-insensitive. id, service, serviceKey, l1, and l2 support exact equality; scope and limitKey support exact equality and literal substring matching. Exact service and serviceKey filters are combined into an exact lockName lookup.

value.description: Success result value for completed entries (Run, Call, GetState, Output, Awakeable, etc.)

VqueueGateDuration.description: How long a wait was held at one scheduling gate.

gate.description: Gate key: concurrency_rules, throttling_rules, invoker_concurrency, invoker_throttling, invoker_memory, lock, or deployment_concurrency.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration spent at this gate.

VqueueBlockedResource.description: Parsed BlockedResource from sys_scheduler.blocked_on_json. The fields present depend on resource.

InvocationVqueueFlowControlV2.description: Flow-control context for this invocation and the VQueue that contains it. Queue-level scheduler fields describe the current head, which may be a different entry.

queuePaused.description: Whether dispatch from the VQueue is paused.

inboxCount.description: Current number of entries waiting in the VQueue Inbox.

counts.description: Current VQueue population in each active stage.

timeInStage.description: Elapsed time in the invocation's current active stage, computed at request time. Omitted for Finished.

averageTimeInStage.description: VQueue exponential moving average for the invocation's current stage. Available for Inbox, Running, and Suspended.

headEntryId.description: Current queue-head entry ID. Compare with the invocation ID before describing this invocation itself as blocked.

blockedOn.description: Gate currently blocking the queue head.

VqueueSnapshotResponse.description: Live snapshot of one virtual queue.

objectKey.description: Virtual-object key, present only for virtual objects.

blockedOn.description: Gate the head is currently blocked on, e.g. concurrency_rules.

scheduling.description: Scheduler verdict for the queue head (SchedulingStatus name): dormant (untracked / nothing runnable), empty, ready (head runnable now), scheduled (head waits for a future run_at), blocked (head can't run — see blockedOn). Absent on older servers.

scheduledAt.description: When the head becomes visible / runnable; set only for the 'scheduled' status.

stageAvg.description: EMA of time spent per stage (ISO 8601 durations). Only inbox/running/suspended have averages; queue is the avg time waiting in the queue before dispatch; endToEnd is the total.

events.description: Queue creation and per-target 'last time ANY entry did X' timestamps.

stage.description: Head entry's queue stage: inbox | running | suspended | paused | finished.

status.description: Head entry's lifecycle status: new | scheduled | backing-off | yielded | started | succeeded | failed | cancelled | killed.

transitionedAt.description: When the head entered its current stage/status.

nextAt.description: When the head next runs (scheduled run_at / retry time), if any.

createdAt.description: When the head was first enqueued.

totalBlocks.description: Cumulative per-gate wait of the head entry across all attempts.

nowBlocks.description: Live per-gate wait of the head (up to 7 gates), head-specific and reset when the head changes.

avgBlocks.description: EMA per-gate wait (subset of 4 gates) for the 'usually' ghost bar.

focusedInvocation.description: Fresh list-compatible invocation snapshot for focusEntryId. Omitted when no focusEntryId was supplied or the invocation no longer exists.

focusEntry.description: The requested focused entry. Omitted when no focusEntryId was supplied or the entry does not belong to this queue.

stage.description: Queue stage bucket — the authoritative column the counts are grouped by, distinct from the lifecycle status.

position.description: 1-based rank in the scheduler's current Inbox order: lock ownership, run_at, sequence number, then entry ID.

totalBlocks.description: Cumulative per-gate wait of this entry across all attempts.

latestBlocks.description: Per-gate wait of this entry's most recent attempt.

relatedCommandName.description: Name of the command that caused the error

relatedCommandType.description: Type of the command that caused the error

relatedCommandIndex.description: Index of the command that caused the error
